lcb.note: `lcb --target aarch64-macos --optimize --allocate` on zlib's four `.ssa` files, on a copy of the project; process wall time, 5 runs each (plain: 0.357 s median). The `sample` row includes `leanprof sample`'s no-op `lake build` and its analysis of the profile, so it overstates samply's cost; the `samply` row is samply alone. lcb has no `profile!` scopes, so `run`, `--allocs`, `--counters` and `--frees` time nothing here: their rows are the cost of the probes alone.
